7/G.goal: Situate modern augmented-reality applications within the technology's historical evolution by explaining its four-phase timeline and the major milestones that defined each phase.
7/G.achieves: Gives the learner foundational context for the course by connecting present XR technologies and the upcoming issues-and-challenges lecture to the development of earlier augmented-reality systems.

7/O1.goal: Explain the four-phase timeline of augmented reality's historical development, from experimental systems through basic research and practical applications to commercial deployment.
7/O1.achieves: Provides a historical baseline that helps the learner understand later course topics on XR issues, hardware, software, and system development in relation to how augmented-reality capabilities emerged.
